passages.note: The Indiana General Assembly bill page lists Behning among the co-authors of HB 1296, "Firearms matters"; it prints no operative text.
House Roll Call 382 adopting the conference committee report on HB 1296 records Behning in the Yea column; 30 of 100 members voting were opposed, so it is not near-unanimous.
passages.actor_quote: Bartels Heaton May Soliday Behning Heine Mayfield Speedy

passages.provision_quote: under state or federal law is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana.
passages.note: The enrolled act amends IC 35-47-2-3 so that a person at least eighteen years of age who is not otherwise prohibited needs no state license to carry a handgun, and repeals IC 35-47-2-2 and IC 35-47-2-2.1 outright.

rows.reasoning: Behning co-authored HB 1296 (2022) and voted Yea on the conference committee report adopting it; the enrolled act provides that an adult not otherwise prohibited "under state or federal law is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana." For a state officeholder, removing the state's license to carry is the major firearm restriction the state controls, so the act matches the rung "Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit." The bill is single-subject firearms and the 69-30 tally is not near-unanimous.
